selected_architecture.summary: Across all nine frozen papers, replay a teacher-blind budget28 structural planner, create one-slot leave-one-reservation-origin-out stresses, and compare radius-1 neighborhood rescue against global surviving-intent allocation over the full frozen top12; the latter explicitly reports whether recovery came from unvisited shallow ranks1-3 or true deeper ranks4-12.

scientific_question: Does the one-case neighborhood-rescue mechanism generalize as a structurally stable and lower-cost recovery strategy across the nine-paper corpus, or are origin-dropped selections better recovered by surviving intents—either because the tier1 schedule had not yet visited a shallow candidate or because genuine depth4-12 allocation is required?

established: LOCAL_RESCUE_CONFIRMED shows immediate same-page neighborhood rescue is sufficient on the known fragile teacher-control case: page:p2:s33 is restored teacher-blind and budget28 returns to 9/13 with all seven controls plus e1.a/e6.a.
Independent review limits that result to one-known-case sufficiency; cross-paper robustness is untested.
The nine-paper fixture preserves exact PDFs plus historical evidence-bearing page locations for all nine papers, but proposition-level teacher labels exist only for arxiv:2403.04036.

Therefore a cross-paper experiment may evaluate structural recovery/stability and cost on all nine papers, plus historical page membership as secondary context, but must not claim proposition-level semantic correctness for the eight non-teacher papers.
The frozen generated-intent artifact covers the nine-paper corpus and preserves source-aware and author-anchored accepted intents.
New query generation remains deferred because the known fragile proposition was already exposed under surviving frozen retrieval paths.
NLI_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED, PREDICATE_ARGUMENT_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED, and AMR_GRAPH_CERTIFICATE_REJECTED remain negative evidence against pairwise semantic redundancy certificates.

residual_hypotheses.statement: Origin-fragile selected evidence is often recoverable from immediate same-page context corroborated by surviving retrieval paths, so radius-1 rescue provides structural robustness beyond the single teacher control at lower search breadth than deeper allocation.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: Across paired leave-one-reservation-origin-out stresses, local rescue has unique exact recoveries or matches deeper allocation while examining a smaller candidate universe.

residual_hypotheses.statement: Some fragile selections can be recovered from ranks1-3 of a surviving tier1 intent that the budget28 schedule had not yet visited; the residual is schedule allocation rather than neighborhood context or retrieval depth.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: The global surviving-intent arm uniquely recovers stressed selections and the recovering candidate's best surviving rank is <=3.

residual_hypotheses.statement: Some fragile selections require surviving intent evidence beyond the original top3 frontier.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: The global surviving-intent arm uniquely recovers stressed selections and at least one such recovery has best surviving rank in 4-12.

residual_hypotheses.statement: Local context and surviving-intent allocation recover different origin-dropped selections and should eventually be composed rather than treated as substitutes.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: At least one stress is local-only and at least one different stress is allocation-only.

residual_hypotheses.statement: Neither radius-1 local rescue nor fixed surviving-intent allocation reliably reconstructs origin-dropped selections, motivating an adaptive gap/sufficiency controller.
residual_hypotheses.predicted_observation: Neither mechanism exactly recovers any stressed selection across valid stresses, or baseline/stress coverage is insufficient for a cross-paper conclusion.

evaluation_scope.papers: All nine exact-SHA papers in local-extract-wave1-corpus.v1.json.
evaluation_scope.historical_oracle: Historical evidence-bearing page locations only for all nine papers. These are secondary evaluation context, not proposition-level labels and not selection inputs.
evaluation_scope.teacher_subset: arxiv:2403.04036 remains the only proposition/claim-level teacher subset. The completed run 40143476764 is a frozen calibration result and is not rerun or used to tune this cross-paper experiment.
evaluation_scope.semantic_claim_boundary: Exact recovery of a removed selected proposition is a structural stability metric. Same-page or historical-evidence-page recovery is descriptive secondary evidence. No semantic-support claim is made for unlabeled papers.

mechanism_family_comparison.rationale: Direct generalization of LOCAL_RESCUE_CONFIRMED. Candidate generation is minimal: only immediate same-page neighbors of surviving tier1 reservation seeds.

Fair comparator to local rescue. It considers every unselected proposition in surviving tier1 top12 rankings, then records whether the selected recovery came from ranks1-3 (schedule/visit allocation) or ranks4-12 (true depth extension). This avoids bias from budget28 not necessarily visiting every surviving tier1 intent.
Current evidence does not justify a new controller until the two cheapest static recovery mechanisms are compared across the full corpus.
The known fragile evidence was already present under surviving frozen queries. Query generation is not the smallest remaining premise.
Repeated NLI, predicate-argument, and AMR certificate failures remain negative evidence.

external_research_evidence.lesson: Retriever behavior can degrade under modest query variation, supporting explicit perturbation/path-robustness evaluation.

external_research_evidence.source: Verma et al. NEST: Nested Evidence Survival for Retrieval. ACL Industry 2026.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Lightweight evidence-survival mechanisms can rescue context lost by static retrieval while separating recall amplification from precision selection.

external_research_evidence.source: Banerjee et al. The Bottleneck Is Retrieval, Not Reading. Findings EMNLP 2026.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Similarity retrieval often surfaces some but not all required evidence, and chunking can destroy useful document context; retrieval/context structure should be tested directly.

external_research_evidence.source: Singh et al. SPLADE-COVER: Coverage-Aware Representations for Learned Sparse Retrieval. EMNLP 2026.
external_research_evidence.lesson: Multi-aspect coverage is a distinct retrieval objective; EXTRACT uses this only as motivation for coverage evaluation, not to import a new learned model.

selected_discriminating_experiment.purpose: Compare radius-1 local rescue with global surviving-intent allocation under matched one-slot origin-drop stresses across the exact nine-paper corpus, while separately identifying whether allocation recoveries come from unvisited shallow ranks1-3 or true depth4-12.

completed_teacher_calibration.role: Frozen prior evidence only; do not rerun or use to tune cross-paper rules.

teacher_blind_cross_paper_baseline.core: For each paper, compute source-aware BM25 rankings for all accepted source-aware intents exactly as stored, with no teacher anti-leak filtering, and RRF-merge to a 24-proposition core using the frozen Wave7A.3 RRF parameters.
teacher_blind_cross_paper_baseline.tier1_reservations: Append four propositions, or fail baseline completeness for that paper, using only tier1 source facet=method and author anchor_role=contribution intents in exact accepted artifact order, alternating source-group then author-group and scanning each visited intent's top3 for the highest-ranked unseen proposition.
teacher_blind_cross_paper_baseline.reason_for_no_teacher_filter: Cross-paper selection must not depend on teacher labels; the historical teacher anti-leak filter is not available for eight papers and is excluded from this baseline.

operation: Require the teacher-blind baseline to contain exactly 24 core propositions plus four tier1 reservation events.
Create four stress cases per valid paper, one for each reservation event in frontier order.
For one stress case, remove exactly that reservation proposition from the 28-set, yielding 27 propositions.
Exclude that reservation event's selecting intent (generator_id + intent_index) from all recovery-path support for that stress.
Do not remove or alter any other selected proposition, query, rank, or intent.
The removed proposition identity is hidden from both recovery arms and is used only for posthoc structural exact-recovery scoring.
stress_generator.baseline_completeness_gate: All nine papers must produce exactly four tier1 reservation events at budget28. If any paper cannot, verdict is INSUFFICIENT_BASELINE_GENERALIZATION and no mechanism preference is authorized.

candidate_generation: Use the three surviving non-core reservation propositions as seeds in original frontier order.
Generate immediate predecessor and successor propositions on the same authoritative PDF page only.
Exclude already-selected propositions and cross-page neighbors.
A neighbor is eligible only if it appears within top12 of at least one surviving tier1 intent.
arm_a_local_neighborhood.action: Append exactly the top-ranked eligible candidate; if none, arm returns NO_CANDIDATE.

provenance: all baseline/rescue propositions exactly locatable to authoritative PDF page/proposition identity
no teacher data used in baseline/stress/candidate generation/ranking

INSUFFICIENT_BASELINE_GENERALIZATION: At least one of the nine papers fails to produce exactly four tier1 reservation events at teacher-blind budget28, or any identity/provenance/teacher-boundary gate fails.
Interpretation: the selected cross-paper baseline itself does not generalize cleanly enough to compare recovery mechanisms. No mechanism preference.
COMPLEMENTARY_STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY: Interpretation: local context and surviving-intent allocation recover different origin-dropped selections; next design should test a deterministic hybrid rather than choose one family.
LOCAL_STRUCTURAL_ADVANTAGE: Interpretation: radius-1 rescue adds structural recovery unavailable to global surviving-intent allocation across the frozen stresses. Cost metrics determine whether later generalization should preserve it as the primary recovery layer.
SURVIVING_ALLOCATION_ADVANTAGE: Interpretation: global surviving-intent allocation adds structural recovery unavailable to radius-1 rescue. The predeclared rank-stratum counts distinguish whether the advantage is primarily unvisited shallow schedule allocation (ranks1-3), true depth extension (ranks4-12), or both.
BOTH_STRUCTURALLY_WEAK: Interpretation: neither static recovery family reconstructs any origin-dropped selection; move toward adaptive gap/sufficiency planning rather than tuning radius or depth post hoc.
EQUIVALENT_STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY: Interpretation: both mechanisms recover exactly the same stress cases. Use predeclared cost metrics and allocation rank-stratum evidence to decide the cheaper/simpler bounded follow-up; this is structural equivalence, not semantic equivalence.

selected_discriminating_experiment.stopping_rule: Exactly one valid scientific execution after independent design review. Stop at the first verdict in interpretation_priority. No changes to corpus, baseline construction, four stress cases per paper, dropped-origin rule, radius1, top12 allocation pool, rank-stratum definition, ranking rules, budget28, metrics, or interpretation after seeing the result.

pass_authority.INSUFFICIENT_BASELINE_GENERALIZATION: No recovery-family authority. Redesign the cross-paper baseline teacher-blind before comparing rescue mechanisms.
pass_authority.COMPLEMENTARY_STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY: Authorize a later deterministic hybrid recovery design, still teacher-blind and fixed-budget; no production promotion.
pass_authority.LOCAL_STRUCTURAL_ADVANTAGE: Authorize a later broader neighborhood-aware robustness/cost design and collection of genuinely proposition-level heldout labels before semantic generalization.
pass_authority.SURVIVING_ALLOCATION_ADVANTAGE: If exact-recovery advantage is predominantly SHALLOW_FRONTIER, authorize schedule-allocation redesign; if predominantly DEPTH_EXTENSION, authorize deeper-per-intent robustness/cost design; if mixed, keep both hypotheses live. Collect proposition-level heldout labels before semantic generalization.
pass_authority.BOTH_STRUCTURALLY_WEAK: Authorize evidence-first adaptive gap/sufficiency-controller research; do not tune radius/depth post hoc.
pass_authority.EQUIVALENT_STRUCTURAL_RECOVERY: Authorize only the lower-cost/simpler mechanism as the next bounded structural robustness design; if cost is tied, require a new discriminator rather than arbitrary selection.

candidate_generation: Use all unique unselected propositions appearing within BM25 top12 of surviving tier1 intents.
Do not use adjacency, teacher labels, semantic similarity, or new queries.
Annotate every candidate with best surviving BM25 rank and rank_stratum=SHALLOW_FRONTIER for ranks1-3 or DEPTH_EXTENSION for ranks4-12.
candidate_ranking: earliest surviving intent accepted-order index ascending
arm_b_surviving_intent_allocation.action: Append exactly the top-ranked eligible candidate; if none, arm returns NO_CANDIDATE.

reviewer_boundary: Independent reviewer must audit this exact frozen cross-paper design before implementation. Routine implementation/CI/trigger mechanics do not require reviewer stops unless science changes. Genuine result requires post-result review before next-phase selection.
next_safe_action: Run normal CI on this design-only artifact and merge only if clean. Then checkpoint the exact design in workspace-control and obtain independent review before implementing LEAVE_ONE_RESERVATION_ORIGIN_OUT_COMPARISON_V1.

review_correction.reason: Pre-implementation audit found that budget28 may stop before every tier1 intent has been visited, so excluding surviving ranks1-3 from Arm B would bias the comparison against non-local allocation.
correction: Arm B now considers all surviving tier1 top12 candidates.
Every Arm B candidate is labeled SHALLOW_FRONTIER (rank1-3) or DEPTH_EXTENSION (rank4-12), so the experiment distinguishes schedule-allocation failure from true retrieval-depth failure.
Arm A, stress generation, fixed budget28, teacher-blind boundary, historical-page secondary metrics, and one-run stopping rule are unchanged.
